claims.claim: The 20th Cheongsong Apple Festival is scheduled for Nov 4-8, 2026, 09:00-20:00, near Hyeonbiam on Yongjeoncheon in Cheongsong-eup; admission is free, some experiences may cost extra.

The official festival website lists Apple Nanta, Apple sorting lottery, Find the Golden Apple, apple parade and other participatory programs; daily schedule and parking/map details are linked separately.
The Ministry of Culture festival listing warns that organizer circumstances may change the event.

sources.body: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism festival listing: Nov 4-8, 2026, 09:00-20:00; Yongjeoncheon Hyeonbiam area in Cheongsong-eup; free entry with some paid experiences; hosted by Cheongsong-gun; contact 054-873-3686. Listed activities include Apple Nanta and Apple Sorting Lotto. Schedule subject to organizer changes.
